concept.title: How to disconnect portable charger (ICCB: In-Cable Control Box)

section.title: Simple operation

li.p: Pull it out while pushing the unlock button (1) on the charging connector.

section.p: For more details, refer to the full manual on the vehicle system.

li.p: Hold the charging connector handle and pull it out while pushing the unlock button (1) on the charging connector.
Make sure to completely close the charging door.
Disconnect the plug from the household electric outlet. Do not pull the cable when disconnecting the plug.
Close the protection caps of the charging connector and the charging plug to protect them from foreign substances.
If the personal charging connector is used, store the connector in the cable compartment.
